system.limits: Pilot results do not discharge these obligations
system.scope: Proof admission, authorization, nullifier/volume lifecycle, host durability, Bankd settlement and Orbis release

range_volume.limits: Requires a matching clean-pin circuit receipt. Export, coefficient translation and full-relation row membership are trusted joins. Full-family/VK, hash, membership and eligibility-policy semantics are excluded
range_volume.scope: All-assignment soundness and legal-input completeness for isolated public 128-bit range and the precise actual Transfer volume arithmetic slice, including caller bounds

backend.limits: No formal qualification of backend or setup established
backend.scope: Exact patched Commonware Pari soundness, cryptographic assumptions and setup

snapshot_freeze.limits: Requires a matching clean-pin full-state receipt. Finite TLC safety bounds and concrete Rust replay cases do not establish implementation refinement or liveness
snapshot_freeze.scope: Paired snapshot admission, freeze epochs, cached execution and durable restart
